topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Rain pounds the concrete harder than my steps. City lights smear into streaks, and every face ducks under a cloak of anonymity. Got a call today, thought it was the break I’ve been chasing. Turns out, it was a setup, just not the kind I was looking for. Some friend, fancying themselves a fixer, tried to throw a bash. Lied about it being big, said it would lift the spirits. Course, it’s all off now. Never could trust a surprise in this town, not with the way people’s faces crumple faster than a paper sack in a storm. Now, I’m left with the echo of laughter that never happened and streets that never sleep, both reminding me of what I don’t need.
